metadata.derivativeDatabaseNotice: Derived from the dawum.de election polling database. This derivative Pollframe database is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0.
metadata.changes: Filtered to seven selected institutes and records from 2017; fields normalised and renamed; records split by parliament; Pollframe averages and state movements calculated separately. Polls from a rights-pending source are temporarily excluded.
metadata.inclusionRule: Seven established institutes with published fieldwork and sample metadata. The reusable DAWUM archive begins in 2017.
